standard_prerequisites.name: Law of excluded middle as a type
standard_prerequisites.statement: The law of excluded middle is the type of functions sending each type A to an element of the coproduct of A with its negation.

standard_prerequisites.name: Failure of double negation
standard_prerequisites.statement: It is not the case that every doubly negated type implies the type itself.
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the earlier result the argument is reduced to, and it is retained as a navigation pointer.

standard_prerequisites.name: Case analysis on a coproduct
standard_prerequisites.statement: An element of a coproduct may be assumed to be in either summand, and the empty type yields any conclusion.
standard_prerequisites.use: It is how each of the two cases is discharged.

core_obligations: Assume a function assigning to every type an element of the coproduct of that type with its negation (source line 239).
Derive from it a function sending every doubly negated type to the type itself, which is the statement known to fail (source lines 241-242).
For a fixed type A and an element of its double negation, case split on the assumed coproduct element (source lines 243-244).

Discharge the left case by the given element of A and the right case by applying the double negation to the negated component, which yields an element of the empty type and hence anything (source lines 244-246).

proof_roadmap.step: Reduce excluded middle to the failure of double negation.
Case split and discharge both cases.

difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the author labelled corollary at source lines 234-237 (book Corollary 3.2.7): it is not the case that every type A satisfies A or not A. The statement is a global negative claim and the proof (source lines 238-246) has to manufacture it out of the earlier failure of double negation: it assumes the excluded middle function, derives from it the double-negation elimination that is known to fail, and then, inside that derivation, performs a case analysis on the coproduct element in which the left case is immediate and the right case is closed by feeding the negated component to the given element of the double negation. Which earlier result is invoked, and why the coprodut case analysis suffices, are absent from the statement.
